title: Sri Lanka Tour with Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
highlights: Explore Sri Lanka with Kandy’s historic temples, Bentota’s serene beaches, and Colombo’s vibrant cityscape.
Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery to witness baby turtles up close, learn about their conservation, and support efforts to protect the turtles.
Experience thrilling water sports at Bentota Beach, where you can enjoy activities like jet skiing, windsurfing, and parasailing.
Visit the Lotus Tower in Colombo, a striking lotus-inspired design and the tallest structure in South Asia, offering spectacular panoramic views.
Discover the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple in Colombo, a historic site renowned for its intricate architecture, and rich collection of Buddhist artifacts.
overview:
About the Tour:
Endowed with a diverse collection of landscapes, climates, natural features and infamous beaches Sri Lanka has been enticing visitors for many years. Offering a myriad range of fun, adventure, and romance, it is among the best destinations in the world for those looking for an exotic vacation with a luxrious stay at Cinnamon property. Enjoy every minute of it. Be it the ocean, the forest or even the city, you’ll be able to soak it all in, what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.


Quick Info:
Route: Colombo - Kandy - Bentota - Colombo
Duration: 5 Days 4 Nights
Start Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)
End Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Deluxe Hotel
1 night stay in Kandy with breakfast and lunch or dinner
2 nights stay in Bentota with breakfast and lunch or dinner
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast and lunch or dinner
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: All visitors need to carry a valid ID proof.
The above mentioned rates for the package are valid for the Indian Nationals only.
All entry tickets for stupas, monasteries, sightseeing, state and entry fees, jeep safari, boat rides, monument entrances, camera charges, permits, etc. are not a part of the package.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
The above rates would vary and won't be the same on special days such as Diwali, Dussehra, Christmas and New Years.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy | Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Colombo! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to Kandy. En route, make a stop at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. There, enjoy observing and learning about the elephants in this sanctuary. Upon arrival in Kandy, check into your hotel and rest for some time. In the afternoon, get driven on the scenic Upper Lake for the stunning views of the lake and surroundings. Later, experience a vibrant Kandyan Dance performance, before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to Bentota. On the way, make a stop at the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery. There, witness the care given to newly laid eggs, see baby turtles up close, and learn about the conservation challenges faced by turtles. Upon arrival in Bentota, check into your hotel and spend a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get transferred for a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Start with a captivating boat ride along the picturesque Madu River, where you can unwind with a soothing fish pedicure. Experience the thrill of water sports at Bentota Beach, with options like jet skiing and banana boat rides. Discover the enchanting cinnamon plantations, indulging yourself in the rich aromas and local agriculture. Afterward, board your transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and get driven to Colombo. Upon arrival, check into your hotel & rest for some time. Later, get transferred for a sightseeing tour. Start with exploring the historic Gangaramaya Temple, known for its intricate architecture. Next, visit the Colombo Lotus Tower, the tallest building in South Asia, providing breathtaking views of the city. Then, visit the bustling Pettah Floating Market and relax at Galle Face Green. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the airport for your journey onward. This marks the end of your trip.
